# A09-S116: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

We have agreed on the following:

Tid:

  1.   Workshop Friday the 28. October from 9 – 11 (12)
  2.   Workshop Monday the 31. October from 9 – 11

Target group: 9. grade, 10. grade, 1. year of gymnasium

Number: one class per workshop

Requirement: students bring their own computer – possibly two students can share one computer

Preparation for registered classes: one week before the workshop links with some background text and tools (notebooks) will be sent that the class needs to look at. Time use: one lesson

Text for our culture package:
 Heading: Find your voice with artificial intelligence

Workshop description: basically just your own text – after looking at the other things we have, I think the length is just fine. And it’s good with additional links.

For us to upload it, you just need to send one or more pictures of at least 1 MB, which you “own” yourself, that we can use in our post on our culture package. Could you also send your text as a Word document so it can be directly uploaded to Kulturpakken?

Link to our culture package is here: Forside (kulturpakken.dk)<http://kulturpakken.dk/>  If you have time, you might take a quick look to see how our other events are described.
